achievements.name: Whip Swing
achievements.detail: Latch the Vampire Killer onto an anchor and swing across a gap.

achievements.name: Prey Pounce
achievements.detail: Hook the whip onto an enemy and pull yourself in to strike.

achievements.name: Arcana Spell
achievements.detail: Cast a spell from an Arcana after a defeated boss has been sealed into a tarot card.

achievements.name: Special Action
achievements.detail: Use the special action that belongs to an equipped Arcana.

achievements.name: Death Sealed
achievements.detail: Defeat Death and seal that boss into an Arcana card.

achievements.name: Medusa Sealed
achievements.detail: Defeat Medusa and add her Arcana to Rose's deck.

achievements.name: Carmilla Sealed
achievements.detail: Defeat Carmilla and seal her into an Arcana card.

achievements.name: Joan Sealed
achievements.detail: Defeat Joan of Arc and seal that boss into an Arcana card.

achievements.name: Seven Categories
achievements.detail: Equip a weapon from each of the seven weapon categories.

achievements.name: Relic Set
achievements.detail: Equip relics that change Rose's offense and defense.

achievements.name: New Route
achievements.detail: Explore into a new stretch of the map and open a shortcut through it.

achievements.name: Highest Tier
achievements.detail: Raise one weapon family to its highest upgrade tier.
